name: SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of Japanese food restaurant in Japan. It operates restaurants under the Washoku Sato, Tendon & Tempura Honpo Santen, Nigiri CHOJIRO, Miyamoto Munashi, Katsuya, Kazokutei, Umaihirekan, Tokutoku, Himawari, Torisho, Gyuno Fuku, and Karayama brand names, as well as operates a Japanese traditional café under the Meotozenzai name. The company was formerly known as Sato Restaurant Systems Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd. in October 2017. SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
